summary: Bot prudence (issue 902): effects on both sides only when the opponent loses clearly more; create a cheap Personality first; bows never aimed at bowed cards (the bot kept the engine's default first-legal target for every targeted ability, now it chooses by intent); never claim the first battle action as Defender or without units on both sides; keep Gold for the Dynasty phase in the first turns. Touches bot (rules lane) plus bot tests and docs.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client exit 0; prudence tests 6/6; arena (L5R_ARENA_SPEC=prudence, 12 decks, 264 games): 174 wins vs 90 without the rules (65.9%, p<0.0001).
